description: Week time grid composing day-view-style columns in a semantic table. Defaults to the current week (locale first day); today's header has aria-current="date". Changing data-start-date, data-days, data-start-hour, data-end-hour or a data-label-* after upgrade rebuilds a generated table.

attributes.name: data-start-date
attributes.description: ISO date for the first day of the view (e.g., 2026-04-06). Default: the current week, starting on the locale's first day of week (Intl.Locale weekInfo, closest [lang]).

attributes.name: data-days
attributes.description: Number of day columns, clamped to 1-14 (e.g., 5 for a workweek). Invalid values fall back to 7.

attributes.name: data-start-hour
attributes.description: First visible hour (0-23), or 'auto' to scan events. A fixed range grows to fit events outside it.

attributes.name: data-end-hour
attributes.description: Last visible hour (0-23). Ignored when data-start-hour is 'auto'.

attributes.name: data-label-continues
attributes.description: Text appended to the accessible name of a spanning event that runs past the last visible hour (localisation hook).

attributes.name: data-label-time
attributes.description: Visually hidden name of the corner header over the hour labels (localisation hook).

events.name: week-view:event-click
events.description: Fired when a calendar-event is clicked, or activated with Enter/Space while focused
events.detail: { date, time, text, element, category, duration }

events.name: week-view:events-changed
events.description: Fired after the events property rebuilds the view

properties.name: events
properties.type: Array<{ date?, time, text, category?, duration? }>
properties.description: Get the week's events as data (including unplaced ones outside the range), or assign an array to rebuild the table. time is HH:MM or a full ISO datetime (its date is used when date is omitted). Durations (data-duration): 2h, 1.5h, 45m, 90m, 1h30m, bare minutes (60), ISO-8601 (PT1H30M); unparseable values fall back to 1 hour.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Re-measure and re-position spanning events now (they also re-position automatically when the view resizes)

childAttributes.name: data-date
childAttributes.description: ISO date assigning this event to a day column (auto mode). Events outside the range, or without a time, are not placed and are hidden.

childAttributes.name: data-duration
childAttributes.description: Makes the event span hour rows. Durations (data-duration): 2h, 1.5h, 45m, 90m, 1h30m, bare minutes (60), ISO-8601 (PT1H30M); unparseable values fall back to 1 hour. Overlapping spans in one day column are laid out side by side.

childAttributes.name: data-continues
childAttributes.description: Set by the component (not authored) on a spanning event clipped at the last visible hour.

structure.description: Day column headers: <time datetime> with a short visible date (month added when the range crosses one) and a visually hidden full date; today's has aria-current="date"
Day/hour cell containing hour-view and calendar-event elements
Subgrid container for events within a cell
Individual event with time, category, and optional duration
